about: Indranil's glove renders (Blender, 20 Oct 2026: x_hand; L re-rendered upright, wrist at the bottom; and G re-rendered twice the same day, the last with the index pointing and the thumb along it; JT chose L X G for Thursday's demo, right hand only) cut out of their black backgrounds by tools/ghost-hands/gloves/cut.py and saved 720 px on the long side. Each is a RIGHT hand as it looks on the learner's own (mirrored) screen. W is the wrist and M the middle finger's knuckle, as fractions of the image (x from the left, y from the top). They size and place the glove (experiments/asl-tutor/glove.js). L, G and X: where the site's hand model (MediaPipe hand_landmarker float16/1) found them on the renders recoloured to skin (tools/ghost-hands/gloves/detect.py), median of its readings, the wrist moved to where the hand meets the cuff.
